t: This is Lindley Hall on Elverton Street, close to Vincent Square. It's an exhibition hall with offices, and it's the older of the two Royal Horticultural Halls. The other is Lawrence Hall, which is nearby but is no longer owned by the Royal Horticultural Society. Lindley Hall is still owned by RHS Enterprises, part of the society's charity. It was designed by Edwin James Stubbs. Beyond that, the records here are thin, so I'll leave it there and let you take a look at the building itself.
